blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Tuesday allowed former House Speaker Martin Romualdez to attend his arraignment and pretrial proceedings via videoconference. The tribunal issued the resolution in response to an urgent motion filed by Romualdez’s camp. The court ordered the Quezon City Jail warden to assist Romualdez and provide him with the necessary facilities, services, and equipment.
